messages:
lucy-partnerships: Heads-up: CloudPort asked for an evidence bundle for marketplace listing — SOC2 summary, latest pen-test (redacted ok), vendor questionnaire, plus a short control mapping. They want a single presigned zip link by Tuesday AM.

carl-security: I'll own the SOC2 summary and control mapping 1-pager. Will keep it high-level (control IDs + descriptions).

mina-si: We have the pen-test raw and a redacted export. Raw is in gs://evidence/cloudport/pen/raw/2025-04-10/pen.pdf; redacted copy gs://evidence/cloudport/pen/redacted/pen_redacted.pdf. For portal upload we should deliver the redacted PDF + redaction_log.txt.

jess-legal: Reminder: redacted bundles still need an attestation email confirming no customer PII or secrets. If they request raw artifacts, NDA + exec sign-off required. I'll paste attestation template.

jess-legal: ```
Attestation v1
- Owner: <name>
- Artifacts: <filenames>
- Redacted by: <name> (method)
- Statement: No customer personal data or credentials included.
- NDA ref (if raw): <contract id>
- Date / Signature:
```

mina-si: Upload plan: create folder cloudport_marketplace_2025-04, include manifest.sha256 with sha256s, include redaction_log.txt, control-mapping.pdf, soc2_summary.pdf, questionnaire.xlsx. Zip as cloudport_evidence_202504.zip and presign with TTL=604800s (7d) and max-downloads=5. I'll stage and post link.

infra-bot: [system] marketplace-uploader role granted to mina-si until 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z.

lucy-partnerships: Please tag S3 metadata: partner=cloudport, listing=marketplace, retention=90d. After 90 days copy to archive per retention policy. Also provide partner PM email for scheduling witness session (no phone numbers).

carl-security: I'll produce the redaction checklist and run secret-scan (trufflehog) before packaging. Expect SOC2 summary by Monday EOD.

jess-legal: Once Mina confirms filenames I'll pre-fill attestation and sign off on the redacted bundle.

mina-si: Owners and handoffs:
- mina-si: presign + zip + manifest
- carl-security: redaction + SOC2 summary + scan report
- jess-legal: attestation + NDA check
- lucy-partnerships: partner comms + portal link

lucy-partnerships: Sync Friday 9:30am PT to confirm artifacts. I'll invite CloudPort PM. :thumbsup:
